verdict.rationale: Stagehand v4 has an 'MCP integrations' best-practices page that explains how to interleave MCP tool results with Stagehand's primitives. But v4 has no autonomous loop, so the developer writes the orchestration and calls the MCP tools manually; Stagehand does not natively attach MCP servers and invoke their tools itself. The evidence about Stagehand exposing its own MCP server (Claude Code/stdio, the hackathon MCP server) is server-side and not credited here. Missing for 10: native MCP client configuration where agent() discovers and invokes MCP server tools, detailed docs on connecting servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
